name: Max HP icon
description: Passive icon: a heart built the classic way, two lobes over a point. Port of the hand-drawn i_maxhp from Feelers' BootScene. Rim is `$blood`, the same as `ss.icon.vine`: this passive is the Vine evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar, in the red of the solutions the two are drawn from on the level-up. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar. It was `$sage`, a grey-green that sat ΔE 16.5 from Plus One's lime `$bile`; the plain green stands 20.6 off it.
